newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Henkel 9-mth pretax profit up six pct.
newsitem.headline: Henkel 9-mth pretax profit up six pct.

text.p: Germany's chemicals and consumer products group Henkel KGaA said on Tuesday pre-tax profit in the first nine months rose six percent to 550 million marks and sales jumped 15 percent to 12.1 billion marks.
The group said it was confident of reaching its full-year sales and earnings targets.
The Duesseldorf-based group said domestic sales climbed 12 percent and foreign business increased 18 percent over the year-ago period.
Investments for the first nine months totalled 352 million marks.

Henkel said the 280 million mark takeover of U.S. Novamax Technologies would further strengthen its metallochemical business. In this division, Henkel reported a nine percent rise in sales to 762 million marks.
Chemical product sales rose three percent to 3.148 billion marks despite a slump in the domestic market.
Adhesive sales were 16 percent higher at 1.878 billion marks. Cosmetics and bodycare turnover touched a record 1.986 billion marks.
Henkel said it had successfully integrated Hans Schwarzkopf GmbH. "The synergies expected at the time of the acquisition have taken effect as planned," it said.

Cleaning products continued the positive development seen in the first half. Nine-month turnover was six percent up on the year-ago period at 3.168 billion marks thanks mainly to growth in Russia, China and Egypt.
The Henkel-Ecolab joint venture reported sales of 1.052 billion marks, which is up three percent on the year-ago period.
